description: This file defines an abstract class 'IntegrationTestCase' in the 'Twig\Test' namespace, which provides helper methods for running integration tests on the Twig templating engine. It includes methods for setting up fixtures, running tests with various configurations, and handling test data and exceptions.

classes.name: IntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing utility methods to facilitate integration testing of Twig templates, including test data parsing, fixture management, and test execution logic.

methods.name: getFixturesDir
methods.description: Deprecated method to get fixtures directory path, throws NotImplemented if not overridden.

methods.name: getFixturesDirectory
methods.description: Abstract method to get fixtures directory path, intended to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: getRuntimeLoaders
methods.description: Returns an array of RuntimeLoaderInterface instances; can be overridden to provide custom runtime loaders.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an array of ExtensionInterface instances to add to Twig environment; can be overridden.

methods.name: getTwigFilters
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigFilter instances to add; can be overridden.

methods.name: getTwigFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigFunction instances to add; can be overridden.

methods.name: getTwigTests
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigTest instances; can be overridden.

methods.name: testIntegration
methods.description: Runs an integration test with provided parameters; invokes internal testing logic.

methods.name: testLegacyIntegration
methods.description: Runs a legacy style integration test; marked with @group legacy.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Discovers test cases from fixture files in the fixtures directory; returns array of test parameters.

methods.name: doIntegrationTest
methods.description: Internal method executing the actual template compilation and rendering assertions based on provided test data.

methods.name: parseTemplates
methods.description: Parses template definitions from test fixture content, returning an array of template name to source code mappings.
